from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib,shutil
p=json.loads(sys.argv[1])
def digest(f): return hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert digest(Path(p['source']))==p['source_sha256']
assert digest(Path(p['compiled_source']))==p['source_sha256']
for f in p['files']:
 s=Path(f['origin']); t=Path(f['target'])
 assert digest(s)==f['sha256']
 if t.exists():
  assert digest(t)==f['sha256']
 else:
  t.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  shutil.copy2(s,t)
 assert digest(t)==f['sha256']
print('REUSED_CACHE '+json.dumps(p))
